summary: Live Supabase profiles user-scoped RLS validation is pending and must pass against the target project before this item can be completed.

requiredProfileProofCases.requirement: public.profiles has row-level security enabled with at least one self-scoped authenticated policy.
Authenticated user/tenant A cannot read the profile row owned by authenticated user B.
Authenticated user/tenant A cannot insert a profile row for another user.
Authenticated user/tenant A cannot update the profile row owned by authenticated user B.
Authenticated user/tenant A cannot delete the profile row owned by authenticated user B.
Authenticated user B can read their own public.profiles row.

completionRule: Only scripts/security/run-supabase-live-tenant-isolation.mjs may mark this evidence Complete after a successful live profiles RLS run against the target Supabase project.
productionGate: Public production remains blocked while this evidence status is Open.
